integration_notes: Reuse the same forecast.causal and panel; do not generate or choose scenarios separately per policy/candidate path.
The entered_at/solver/action deadline window remains coordinator-owned and must include scenario-generation overhead.
Use canonical imports from the same resume-mvp module directory; no duplicate CausalScenario/StateVersion classes.
Factory validation binds snapshot/clock and source freshness, but planner/coordinator still own expected model identity, current-version/CAS/actual-application/permission checks.
No optional online prior adaptation in v1; the immutable Train prior is not reread/refit at each decision.
limitations: Measured lengths refer only to Mayor-reported Train tokenizer proof at the pinned fingerprint; generated future lengths remain nominal draws, not Eval/backend-cost measurements.
Poisson arrival process and independent length marks are an uncalibrated nominal forecast, not an identified Native predictive law.
Actual coordinator source_digest adoption, real transport/current state, approval and application evidence remain outside these two files.
No peer unsealed coordinator was read; no claim was made that its implementation was independently inspected.
